name: layout
import: import { Container, Divider, Flex, Grid, Stack } from '@absoluteui/components/layout';
purpose: Layout primitives as CSS classes that work without JavaScript (aui-container, aui-stack, aui-flex, aui-inline, aui-grid, aui-divider, aui-gap-*, aui-align-*, aui-justify-*), plus thin, validated JS helpers that apply the same classes and custom properties to consumer elements and remove exactly what they added.
whenToUse: Spacing siblings with token gaps instead of ad-hoc margins.
Responsive card or tile grids that reflow without media queries (aui-grid--auto).
Centering page content with a token maximum width (aui-container).
Separating groups of content with a semantic or decorative divider.
whenNotToUse: Visual grouping with a border or background: use Surface or Card.
Tabular data: use a table (Data Table in a later release).
Reordering content visually so it differs from the reading order (flex row-reverse on meaningful sequences).
responsive: Flex rows wrap by default. Auto-fit grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(var(--aui-grid-min, 16rem), 100%), 1fr)), so a column never exceeds the container and content reflows to one column at narrow widths. Fixed column counts (aui-grid--cols-N) do not collapse; prefer auto mode for reflow. Containers cap max-inline-size with container-width-* tokens and keep space-4 inline padding.
rtl: Logical properties throughout (max-inline-size, margin-inline, padding-inline, border-inline-start). Flex rows follow the writing direction, so start/end alignment and row order mirror automatically in RTL.
theme: Spacing uses space-* tokens; divider lines use color-border and labels color-text-muted. Forced-colors mode draws divider lines in CanvasText.
security: Helpers only add classes and set the --aui-grid-min custom property through the CSSOM (el.style.setProperty); no style attributes, no HTML parsing. minColumnWidth is validated against a strict CSS length pattern that rejects calc(), var(), and declaration injection. Divider labels use textContent. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Constant work per apply()/update(): a few classList operations and at most one custom property. No listeners; one configuration subscription per handle. Not yet part of the e2e performance suite.

limitations: Only one of Stack, Flex, or Grid can own an element at a time (LAYOUT_ALREADY_APPLIED); Container can be combined with any of them.
Fixed grid column counts do not collapse at narrow widths; use columns: 'auto' for reflow.
Labelled dividers are horizontal only; vertical dividers cannot carry text.
Handles that rely on the configured defaultGap re-apply when configuration changes; plain CSS classes use the space-4 default.
unsupported: Arbitrary CSS values for gaps (only the documented space steps).
calc(), var(), or other CSS functions as minColumnWidth.
antiPatterns: Using flex row-reverse to reorder content whose order carries meaning; the reading and focus order stay in source order.
Nesting margins on children of a stack; let the gap own spacing.
Using a divider as the only indication that two regions are separate; use headings or landmarks for structure.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/layout: AuiStack ([auiStack]), AuiFlex ([auiFlex]), AuiGrid ([auiGrid]), and AuiContainer ([auiContainer]) directives; no directive for Divider (use the aui-divider classes).
